title: Authenticate the spawned desktop backend before opening the webview
primary_claim: The Tauri parent opens the operator webview only after its spawned backend returns per-launch child-specific startup evidence, never from TCP reachability alone.

baseline.finding: wait_until_ready accepted any TCP listener that won the race for 127.0.0.1:8765

acceptance: the parent generates a fresh 256-bit nonce from the operating-system RNG for every launch
the nonce reaches only the spawned child environment
generic TCP success or a generic health response cannot satisfy readiness
the backend exposes startup evidence only when launched with a valid child nonce
the parent compares the exact returned nonce before webview construction
child exit is checked before and after a successful readiness probe
startup failure kills and reaps only the spawned child
the frozen-sidecar smoke test verifies nonce-bound readiness
rollback: revert the scoped source and tests together
retain issue 270 and this packet as negative startup-integrity evidence
